notes: SHIP v1.14.407 - FORGE BOTTOM CONTROL STACK, ONE CLEAN PASS. Owner-directed: 'the bottom rack-strip controls are clipping/overlapping, the rack pills and the right-side utility buttons are fighting the focus card below, this is a layout/composition defect.' Measured first, then fixed. THE ROOT CAUSE IS ONE SENTENCE: the control row had no declared height, so every control in it was sized by a sibling. .hudbtn declared width:46px and NO height and took whatever align-items:stretch handed it from the chips next to it. Measured 46x35 populated and 46x24.5 in the honest no-Master zero state, against the app's own --tap-s 44px floor - 9px short populated, 19.5px short empty, on both 390x844 and 834x1194. The rack pills were 76x33 and they carry click handlers, so they were sub-floor too. Everything else followed from that one omission. FOUR CAUSES FIXED. (1) THE ROW NOW DECLARES ITS GEOMETRY ONCE, in a scoped token block: --forge-tap bound to --tap-s, --forge-glow, --forge-gutter, --forge-row-h, --forge-pad-x. Every control consumes the tap floor as ITS OWN height, so nothing is sized by a sibling ever again. Measured after: 46x44 buttons and 76x44 pills in all four chip states on both viewports, and the row is a constant 58px whether the loadout is empty or full. --forge-row-h is written as tap + gutter*2 rather than tap + glow: arithmetically identical today, but only the first states the row's real dependency, so a future change to the gutter cannot silently desynchronise it. (2) THE CHIPS SCROLLER WAS CLIPPING AN AXIS IT NEVER DECLARED. .chips set overflow-x:auto and left overflow-y at visible; per css-overflow-3 the omitted axis blockifies, so it clipped VERTICALLY in silence and amputated the active pill's glow - measured 0.00px of room above the shadow and 2.00px below, against a declared 14px blur. Both axes are now declared and the room is DERIVED: --forge-gutter is half the blur radius, which is the distance a CSS box-shadow stays perceptible, and the SAME --forge-glow token feeds the shadow, so the glow and the room made for it cannot drift apart. Measured after: 7px above, 7px below. (3) THE 92px IS DELETED, NOT RETUNED. .hint was pinned to the VIEWPORT at bottom:calc(safe + 92px), a constant describing a strip that declared no height and measured 108.5-137px, so the caption was drawn ON TOP of the pills in every state measured. It was never derived - the same 92px sits in the source mock's v2, v2.2, v2.8 and v2.9.2, frozen while the stack beneath it was rebuilt. And no constant CAN be right, because .herotag is inline-flex and data-driven (56px focused, 74px when the zero-state message wraps). The caption is now a CHILD of the strip it must clear, at bottom:100% of it - exact at every herotag height on every viewport, with no number to go stale, and it costs the stack nothing because an abspos child adds no height. This is the repo's own fixed-strip-clearance rule (v1.14.341, v1.14.351) satisfied by REMOVING the constant rather than re-deriving it. The caption's white-space:nowrap also went: it was forcing a 59-character string to 472.70px inside a 390px viewport, cut 41px off each end and literally unreadable. (4) THE INVISIBLE TOAST WAS EATING TAPS ON THE PILL ROW. The Forge toast hid itself with opacity alone while keeping pointer-events:auto, display:flex and visibility:visible, so it stayed hit-testable for the life of the sheet - document.elementFromPoint at the centre of the pill strip returned span#toastUndo, not the chip, and the swallowed tap was SILENT because the undo handler no-ops once its callback is null. Hit-testing now follows the same class the visibility does. No JS change. AND ONE BLOCKER THE REQUEST DID NOT NAME, found by opening the aisle on a fresh device rather than by reading the CSS: THE ZERO STATE OPENED WITH A RED ERROR BAR ACROSS BOTH UTILITY BUTTONS. deploy_forge_zeroState called phantomToast with no type argument, and phantomToast defaults colors[type] || colors.error, so an EXPECTED, HONEST condition - no Master on a fresh device - was painted rgba(255,59,59,.9) ERROR RED. #toast-container is fixed far above this sheet's z-index, so it landed across both controls, measured 198x30 covering 11px of each 44px button. It was also the FOURTH copy of the same sentence on one screen: the sheet subtitle, the hint and the focus card all already state it, the last two byte-identically. DELETED rather than re-typed - a non-error colour would fix the lie but keep the redundancy and keep a transient banner lying over the controls. The console.warn keeps the diagnostic. This is the never-label-absent-telemetry rule: a zero state is not an error. THREE OF THE OWNER'S OWN SUSPICIONS ARE REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT AND NO CHANGE WAS MANUFACTURED TO SATISFY THEM. (a) 'the focus card is fighting the control row' - .herotag vs .toprow measured -12.00px, a clean constant GAP equal to .toprow margin-bottom, in every state on both viewports. The thing wedged in that gap was the .hint. The requirement was already met and still is. (b) 'no parent container should clip these controls' - there is no ancestor clip. The sheet, the HUD, .hud-bottom and .toprow all compute overflow:visible, and #forge3d-mount{overflow:hidden} is the HUD's SIBLING, not its ancestor. The only clipping box in the stack was .chips, on its own children, and it was clipping a shadow rather than a layout box. (c) 'accidental negative margins' - zero negative lengths exist anywhere in the block. Reported as refuted rather than silently skipped. ALSO REFUTED, and it changed how this was edited: the patch-stacking premise. git log -L on every rule under scrutiny returns exactly ONE commit each (25a1e29, v1.14.233) and the CSS was still byte-identical to the approved mock, which was authored as a full-window demo and never validated at 390px inside a sheet. Nothing here had ever been patched - so the ban on patch stacking was forward-looking, and the discipline required was to not AUTHOR the first hack. That is why the 92px is deleted rather than retuned. STYLE: unchanged. Glass, blur, borders, radii, colours, fonts and font sizes all verified byte-identical in computed values; the only style-touching edit is .chip.active's blur moving from a literal 14px to var(--forge-glow), which paints the same. Structure, spacing and stacking only. VISIBLE DELTA ON DEVICE: the pill row reads as 44px of glass instead of 33px and the row box is 58px with a 7px transparent glow gutter, so the stack grows 137 to 160px in the zero state at 390; pill content is vertically centred inside the taller pill; the caption moves from lying on top of the pills to sitting 10px above the strip and now wraps instead of running off both edges; the focus card's status dot no longer deforms into an ellipse when the text beside it is long. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, CSS braces 4558/4558 balanced (+1 deliberate: the scoped token rule), CRLF intact with 0 lone LF, PRECACHE untouched, three-stamp lockstep. RACK SCENE LOCK RESPECTED - nothing under #forge3d-mount, forge3d_render, drawGuts or the camera rig was touched; this is the HUD layer outside the scene. ?legacy=1 UNAFFECTED: #forge3d-sheet is body.rd + .open gated and a programmatic sweep of all 12 style blocks confirms zero rules using .chip/.chips/.toprow/.hudbtn/.herotag/.hint outside a #forge3d-sheet-scoped selector. REGRESSION GUARD: new test/e2e/08-forge-layout.spec.js, 8 tests x 5 projects, pins the tap floor in every chip state INCLUDING empty (the state that collapsed), the two buttons as a matched pair, the derived clearance under token perturbation, and the hidden toast at pointer-events:none. Full 7-spec baseline re-run green, 104/104 outcomes unchanged. OPEN, OWNER RULINGS NEEDED, NOT ABSORBED: the Forge toast still carries a magic 96px and still overlaps the control row while shown - moving it under .hud-bottom would put it behind the open detail panel and destroy the UNDO affordance, so it needs a placement ruling; at the real 5-rack loadout cap 2 of 5 pills are off-screen at 390px with no affordance, and both available fixes are restyles the brief forbids; --forge-tap is bound to --tap-s 44px while the app's own token comment argues the gloved-realistic minimum is ~50px and --tap-m 48px already exists - a one-token edit, but the owner's call; .rd-sheet-close is 40x40 and .detail-close is 32x32, both shared or out-of-stack; the zero state states the same sentence three times in three treatments. DEVICE-VERIFY, folded into the open batch pass: clear the service-worker cache, confirm v1.14.407, open the aisle with NO Master and confirm there is NO red bar and no caption lying across the pills, confirm both utility buttons and the pills are comfortably tappable with a gloved hand, load a Master and confirm the pill row and focus card are cleanly separated, and confirm the safe-area inset still holds at the bottom - env(safe-area-inset-bottom) resolves to 0 in the test harness, so the real notch clearance is verified by NOTHING off-device and the iPhone still owns it.
